_comment: PUBLIC scheduled market events only. Add SARB MPC decision dates from the official calendar at https://www.resbank.co.za (Monetary Policy > MPC meeting dates), plus economic-data release dates (CPI, GDP) from Stats SA. A signal firing within EVENT_WINDOW_DAYS (default 3) of an event is treated more cautiously, because prices often gap on the announcement. Do NOT add anything based on non-public information — only official, published, scheduled dates. The 'events' array below is empty by design so nothing fires until you add verified dates; '_example_format' shows the shape.
